content.text: {"Id":"BUG-TRIAGE-111","Title":"Codex workspace session cache rebound by background agent sessions","Section":"Backlog","Priority":"high","Done":false,"Estimate":null,"Note":null,"Description":["The Codex plugin uses a single workspace\u002Bagent cache root (.mcpServer/codex) with one session-state.yaml and current-turn.yaml. cache_scope_init/select_session and openSession/session-start write that shared pointer; session-scoped sessions/ dirs are intentionally flat (TEST-MCP-BUGTRIAGE-028/034). When a background implementation agent bootstraps or openSession-s, it overwrites the workspace active session. Later UserPromptSubmit hooks then beginTurn against the child sessionId while the original root session stays in_progress, fragmenting the audit trail and leaving stale open sessions.","Triage group: triage-group-83cf50aa5a457960","Reports: 1"],"TechnicalDetails":["Acceptance criteria:","- After a background/child Codex agent opens an MCP session in the same workspace, a subsequent root user prompt begins a turn on the original root sessionId, not the child sessionId.","- Bootstrap or openSession for a background agent must not replace the workspace active-session/session-state.yaml pointer used by root UserPromptSubmit hooks unless the caller explicitly targets that session.","- Root session remains the hook-visible active session for the workspace while background agents run, and background agent turns are logged only under their own sessionId.","- Completing or abandoning a background session does not leave the root session stuck in_progress solely because turns were appended elsewhere, and does not strand many orphan in_progress sessions from cache rebinding.","- Regression coverage proves: root session A active, background session B bootstrap/openSession, then UserPromptSubmit beginsTurn with sessionId A (or an explicit parent/root pointer), never silently B.","Implementation notes:","- Primary binding surface is plugins/core/lib-sh/cache-scope.sh: MCP_PLUGIN_SESSION_CACHE_DIR and CACHE_DIR both equal MCP_PLUGIN_CACHE_ROOT; cache_scope_select_session overwrites active-session under that root.","- plugins/core/lib-sh/hook-lib.sh user_prompt_submit_main and plugins/core/lib-ps/plugin-hook.ps1 / repl-invoke.ps1 (Invoke-WorkflowOpenSession, beginTurn) all resolve sessionId from the single workspace session-state.yaml.","- Do not reintroduce unscoped plugin-install caches. Prefer either (a) parent/root sticky active-session with child sessions writing under sessions/\u003CsessionKey\u003E/ only, or (b) explicit MCP_SESSION_ID / parentSessionId so hooks never treat background bootstrap as the workspace default.","- Codex plugin hooks consume shared core; fix belongs in plugins/core (and synced codex plugin package), with Pester coverage extending TEST-MCP-BUGTRIAGE-028/034 for parent vs background session isolation.","- Original report workspace was TruckMate; defect is MCP Server Codex/plugin cache binding and should be remediated in McpServer plugin core."],"ImplementationTasks":null,"CompletedDate":null,"DoneSummary":null,"Remaining":null,"PriorityNote":null,"Reference":null,"Phase":null,"DependsOn":null,"FunctionalRequirements":["FR-MCP-TRIAGE-002"],"TechnicalRequirements":["TR-MCP-TRIAGE-004"],"IdempotencyKey":null}
